function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getLightChart
function.description: Access simplified stock chart data using the FMP Basic Stock Chart API. This API provides essential charting information, including date, price, and trading volume, making it ideal for tracking stock performance with minimal data and creating basic price and volume charts.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getFullChart
function.description: Access full price and volume data for any stock symbol using the FMP Comprehensive Stock Price and Volume Data API. Get detailed insights, including open, high, low, close prices, trading volume, price changes, percentage changes, and volume-weighted average price (VWAP).

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getUnadjustedChart
function.description: Access stock price and volume data without adjustments for stock splits with the FMP Unadjusted Stock Price Chart API. Get accurate insights into stock performance, including open, high, low, and close prices, along with trading volume, without split-related changes.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getDividendAdjustedChart
function.description: Analyze stock performance with dividend adjustments using the FMP Dividend-Adjusted Price Chart API. Access end-of-day price and volume data that accounts for dividend payouts, offering a more comprehensive view of stock trends over time.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getIntradayChart
function.description: Access precise intraday stock price and volume data with the FMP Interval Stock Chart API. Retrieve real-time or historical stock data in intervals, including key information such as open, high, low, and close prices, and trading volume for each minute.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getIndexQuote
function.description: Access real-time stock index quotes with the Stock Index Quote API. Stay updated with the latest price changes, daily highs and lows, volume, and other key metrics for major stock indices around the world.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getIndexShortQuote
function.description: Access concise stock index quotes with the Stock Index Short Quote API. This API provides a snapshot of the current price, change, and volume for stock indexes, making it ideal for users who need a quick overview of market movements.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getAllIndexQuotes
function.description: The All Index Quotes API provides real-time quotes for a wide range of stock indexes, from major market benchmarks to niche indexes. This API allows users to track market performance across multiple indexes in a single request, giving them a broad view of the financial markets.

short.description: Whether to return short quotes (default: false)

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getHistoricalIndexLightChart
function.description: Retrieve end-of-day historical prices for stock indexes using the Historical Price Data API. This API provides essential data such as date, price, and volume, enabling detailed analysis of price movements over time.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getHistoricalIndexFullChart
function.description: Access full historical end-of-day prices for stock indexes using the Detailed Historical Price Data API. This API provides comprehensive information, including open, high, low, close prices, volume, and additional metrics for detailed financial analysis.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getIndex1MinuteData
function.description: Retrieve 1-minute interval intraday data for stock indexes using the Intraday 1-Minute Price Data API. This API provides granular price information, helping users track short-term price movements and trading volume within each minute.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getIndex5MinuteData
function.description: Retrieve 5-minute interval intraday price data for stock indexes using the Intraday 5-Minute Price Data API. This API provides crucial insights into price movements and trading volume within 5-minute windows, ideal for traders who require short-term data.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getIndex1HourData
function.description: Access 1-hour interval intraday data for stock indexes using the Intraday 1-Hour Price Data API. This API provides detailed price movements and volume within hourly intervals, making it ideal for tracking medium-term market trends during the trading day.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getQuote
function.description: Access real-time stock quotes with the FMP Stock Quote API. Get up-to-the-minute prices, changes, and volume data for individual stocks.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getQuoteShort
function.description: Get quick snapshots of real-time stock quotes with the FMP Stock Quote Short API. Access key stock data like current price, volume, and price changes for instant market insights.

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getAftermarketQuote

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getStockPriceChange

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getBatchQuotes

function.name: cfocoder/financial-modeling-prep-mcp-server/getBatchAftermarketQuote

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getStockQuotes
function.description: Essential tool for Real-Time Price Monitoring. Retrieve current market prices, absolute and percentage price changes for multiple US and international securities simultaneously. Use this for live trading analysis and portfolio tracking. Timezone: EST. Supports batching up to 300 identifiers per request.

format.description: Output format. JSON is standard for real-time AI dashboards.

identifiers.description: Comma-separated list of trading symbols (e.g., MSFT,AAPL). Use this to get bulk updates for a watchlist in a single call.

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getStockPrices
function.description: Premium tool for Historical Backtesting and Trend Analysis. Provides over 10 years of daily OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) data for thousands of US and international companies. Use this to analyze long-term price performance, volatility, and historical trading patterns. Supports 300 records per call with pagination.

format.description: Output format. JSON is standard for AI technical analysis.

offset.description: Pagination marker. Increment by 300 to traverse through the 10+ year history.

identifier.description: The unique trading symbol for the security (e.g., MSFT).

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getMinutePrices
function.description: Premium-grade tool for Intraday Analysis and Algorithmic Backtesting. Provides ultra-granular 1-minute historical OHLCV data spanning 8+ years for over 10,000 securities (US, International, and ETFs). Essential for analyzing market micro-structure, price action around specific events, and high-frequency trend identification. Timezone: UTC. Limit: 300 records per call.

date.description: The specific date for the intraday data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

format.description: Output format. JSON is standard for AI-driven technical indicators.

offset.description: Pagination marker. Use to skip records and retrieve the full day's minute data in increments of 300.

identifier.description: The unique trading symbol for the security (e.g., MSFT or AAPL).

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getLatestPrices
function.description: Premium real-time monitoring tool. Provides granular 1-minute OHLCV data for the current trading week across 10,000+ securities (US, International, and ETFs). Ideal for tracking immediate price action, identifying intraday support/resistance, and analyzing volume spikes in the last few days. Timezone: UTC. Limit: 300 records.

format.description: The output format. JSON is optimized for real-time AI pattern recognition.

offset.description: Pagination marker for walking back through time. To retrieve the next 300 minutes of historical data for the current week, increment this value by 300 (e.g., 0, 300, 600) until the target time range is reached.

identifier.description: The unique trading symbol (e.g., MSFT or AAPL).

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getOtcPrices
function.description: Specialized tool for Over-the-Counter (OTC) historical research. Access 10+ years of daily OHLCV data for over 10,000 OTC securities, including small-caps, penny stocks, and ADRs. Essential for analyzing high-risk equity markets and companies not found on major exchanges. Limit: 300 records per call.

format.description: The output format. JSON is optimized for AI-driven sentiment and price analysis.

offset.description: Pagination marker. To walk back through the 10+ year OTC history, increment this value by 300 (e.g., 0, 300, 600) until the target historical date is reached.

identifier.description: The unique OTC trading symbol (e.g., AABB). Use the 'OTC Symbols' endpoint to verify the identifier.

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getIndexQuotes
function.description: Premium benchmark monitoring tool. Retrieve live price data, absolute change, and percentage performance for major global market indices (e.g., S&P 500, Dow Jones). Essential for gauging overall market sentiment and broad economic health in real-time. Timezone: EST. Supports batching up to 300 index identifiers.

format.description: Output format. JSON is standard for real-time benchmark dashboards.

identifiers.description: Comma-separated list of index trading symbols (e.g., ^GSPC,^DJI). Use the 'Index Symbols' endpoint to find specific tickers.

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getIndexPrices
function.description: Tool for long-term Market Benchmarking. Access over 10 years of daily historical OHLCV data for major market indices. Essential for macro-economic research, volatility studies, and comparing individual stock performance against broad market averages like the S&P 500 or Nasdaq. Limit: 300 records per call.

format.description: Output format. JSON is standard for AI technical analysis and charting.

offset.description: Pagination marker for walking back through time. To retrieve the next 300 days of historical index data, increment this value by 300 (e.g., 0, 300, 600) until the target historical date is reached.

identifier.description: The unique index symbol (e.g., ^GSPC). Refer to 'Index Symbols' for a full directory of available benchmarks.

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getEtfQuotes
function.description: Returns real-time price data for exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Includes the last traded price, absolute change, and percentage change. This endpoint is optimized for monitoring broad market trends via major index trackers like SPY and QQQ. Timezone: EST. Limit: 300 records per call.

format.description: The format of the returned data.

identifiers.description: A comma-separated list of ETF trading symbols (e.g., SPY,QQQ).

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getEtfPrices
function.description: Provides over 10 years of historical end-of-day pricing and volume data for major ETFs. Includes Open, High, Low, and Close (OHLC) values. Essential for backtesting, technical analysis, and historical performance tracking. Limit: 300 records per call.

format.description: The format of the returned data.

offset.description: The initial position of the record subset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

identifier.description: The trading symbol for the ETF (e.g., SPY).
